title: Paths join, find parents and tidy by their grammar, never the host

provenance.origin: authored for #492 from the fs/path contract text
provenance.expected_basis: fs/path: lexical paths of the posix and windows grammars; a root is its own parent, also behind a drive or a UNC share; joining tidies `.` and repeated separators and keeps `..`.

notes: C:\ used to lose its root on every engine (#492).
